title: Fold tangled useState calls into useReducer
summary: A form that can be failed and submitting at once gets one reducer, a discriminated union of states and a union of actions.

turns.user: SignupForm: fail once, submit again, and it shows the error AND the spinner. 4 pieces of state, i cant follow it anymore. merge them

assistant.body: Great question! The direct cause is that nothing ever calls setError(null). The deeper one is that four independent useState calls let you forget any of them, and the types stay quiet. Let's make the state a discriminated union and move every transition into one reducer. Submitting and failed at the same time then cannot even be written.
